utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear — what kind of repairs are they focusing on for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Mostly the usual: leaky faucets, loose steps, and a few broken screens. If you’ve got something specific, it’d help to know before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly I’m just glad they’re tackling the basics first. I don’t have anything specific right now, but I’ll keep an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just help spread the word and bring any tools or spare parts you’ve got. I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll spread the word and see what tools or spare parts I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still happening, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and whether we have enough people lined up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good to know — do we need to line up more people, or is the timing the main issue?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I can help, just remind me what’s needed and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren. We still need screws, duct tape, and a couple of small hand tools if you can find them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—I’ll check my shed and see what I can find. I’ll bring anything useful by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t seen the repair-drive details yet—what exactly needs fixing, and when is it happening?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I think it’s mostly the loose fence by the mailbox and that broken step near the community room. I’m pretty sure the drive is this Saturday, but I’d double-check the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—I’ll double-check the flyer before I show up, just to make sure I’ve got the right time and list of repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what part of the repair drive needs the most help?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — the paint and patch supplies are the biggest gap right now, and a few extra hands for sorting would help too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can help sort things, and I’ll see if I can bring some paint and patch supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and maybe some basic hand tools? If you can, just help me set up and sort the donations when folks arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll bring my drill and hand tools and help set up and sort the donations when people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive set up yet, but I can check around the neighborhood and let you know where it is.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — that would be a big help. Let me know if you spot it, especially anything near the school pickup route.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye out near the school pickup route and let you know as soon as I spot it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s been a busy one already—folks are really turning out for the repair drive. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Tess—keep me posted, and I’ll pass the word along if I hear anything too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Quinn—much appreciated. I’m hearing there’s a good mix of volunteers and donations already, so I’ll let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly the loose fence panels and that broken step by the front path. I can point out a couple more spots if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, please point them out—what else should we add to the list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to stop by the repair drive later and spread the word to a few neighbors. Hopefully we can get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s great — I’ve mostly been hearing about it second-hand, so I’m glad you’re spreading the word. Let me know if there’s anything I should pass along too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Nell — I’ll let you know if I hear anything new. I’ll keep mentioning it to folks around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting together the repair drive details now. If you’ve got any items or can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help spread the word. I don’t have any items right now, but I’ll mention it to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Uli — thank you. I’ll share the final details soon so you can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is still on track for this weekend—folks are dropping off tools and spare parts already. If you need anything fixed, it’d be a good time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good to know—I'll bring my old lamp by on Saturday morning. What time are folks starting?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think they’re kicking off around 9 in the morning, maybe a little earlier for setup. I’d come by then so you don’t miss the handy folks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, am I late to the repair drive? I can jump in and help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, you’re not late at all—there’s still plenty to do. Just jump in wherever you can help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks. I’ll start wherever you need me most.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. If you could just help spread the word and keep an eye out for anyone who might need a hand, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll spread the word and check in on folks who might need help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in. Just send me the details and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is at Maple Hall on 3rd Street, Saturday from 10 to 2. I’ll send the full list of needed items too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—Maple Hall on 3rd, Saturday 10 to 2. Send the list when you can and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m thinking the repair drive could really bring everyone together. Want to help me figure out the best way to get the word out?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely—let’s check the details first so we get it right. Who are we trying to reach, and when would you want to spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly the folks on Maple and the people from the community garden, and I’d love to start getting the word out this week.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I must’ve missed the latest details; what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly we just need hands and a little time—if you can help sort donations or do a quick pickup, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can help sort donations or do a pickup. Just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely. Anything you still need me to keep an eye out for?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly just a good cordless drill and a few clamps, if you spot them. Otherwise, we’re in pretty good shape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye out for a cordless drill and some clamps while I’m out. If I spot anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Leo — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — can you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling the pickups. Could we sort out the logistics first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — who’s available to do the pickups, and what time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do a pickup if it’s after 3, but I’d like to know the route and how many stops there are first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, the repair drive’s coming up soon—want me to put you on the invite list?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please put me on the list—I can help keep track of supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll add you right now—thanks for helping with supplies!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup and drop-off times for the repair drive. Just let me know when you’re planning it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Faye—that would really help. I’m still sorting the exact time, but I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send me the time once you have it, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Nell — I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I can help coordinate the donations and drop-off times.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. I’m hearing bits from folks, so just tell me what you need me to pass along or help with.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Could you let folks know we’re especially looking for tools, lumber, and working lights? I’ll keep the drop-off schedule organized and send you any updates.
